name: shop
description: Search H&M, Uniqlo, Old Navy and Kohl's (US) for clothes in the user's sizes and return links. Read through the JSON endpoints the stores' own sites call; nothing is ever added to a cart or bought.

provides_capabilities.title: Clothes shopping
provides_capabilities.summary: Links to items that are in stock in your sizes.
provides_capabilities.setup_hint: herald config set shop.sizes.tops L, and shop.sizes.pants 32/30. Optional: shop.kohls.ssh_host, an ssh alias for a Mac with Google Chrome, turns Kohl's on.

setup.prompt: Your sizes, one per kind of garment, as the stores label them
Anything about fit worth knowing (a kind you size up in, a cut you avoid). Optional
To search Kohl's: the ssh name of a Mac with Google Chrome that this machine can reach. Leave blank to skip Kohl's

steps: Optional, for contact sheets of product photos: ~/herald/venv/bin/pip install pillow
Optional, for Kohl's: ~/herald/venv/bin/pip install playwright, and make the Mac reachable with `ssh <name>` using a key, with Google Chrome installed.
